description: The default tool for "how does the citizenship test work in <country>?". Returns the test name, format, number of questions, duration and pass mark where officially published (some are not, and those fields say so), status, a short explanation, the six study levels, FAQ, the official source and the Civica guide URL. It already includes the official source link, so call get_official_sources only if that link is all you need. Errors with the list of valid countries if the country is unknown.

country.description: Country name or id, e.g. "UK", "United Kingdom", "de", "Germany". Use list_tracks for valid values.

name: get_track_info

disclaimer.description: Independent-app notice; always show it with the facts.

facts.description: Key facts such as format, duration and pass mark.

guideUrl.description: Civica study guide page for this country.

id.description: Track id, usable as the country argument.

officialSource.description: The official government source to verify against.

status.description: in_force, or preview_not_in_force when announced but not yet live.

test.description: Name of the test or exam.
